newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds start rally then run out of steam.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds start rally then run out of steam.

text.p: Danish benchmark bonds wiped out much of Friday's losses in an early spurt on Monday then ground to a virtual halt in a still-edgy market.
"It will take a couple of days to quell the nervousness, but the underlying trend is still positive," a dealer said, adding that he expected trade to pick up toward the end of the week.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 touched 109.00 but closed at 108.83, yielding 6.69 percent, up 0.79 point from Friday's close, but still down 0.72 compared to Thursday, before Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan alarmed markets with a warning against "irrational exuberance".
